item.title: Board of Peace's Gaza envoy criticises Israeli strikes and Hamas actions
item.description: Nickolay Mladenov warns that a collapse of last October's ceasefire would be "a point of no return" for the region.

item.title: What we know about deadly Nepal-Tibet floods
item.description: Hundreds have died in flooding and landslides on the border of Nepal and Tibet.

item.title: Convicted Bosnian Serb war criminal Mladić dies aged 84
item.description: He was jailed for life in 2017 for genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity during the wars in the ex-Yugoslavia in 1992-95.

item.title: Allan Little: I met dangerously fanatical Mladić early in Bosnian war
item.description: BBC special correspondent Allan Little met the "Butcher of Bosnia" in the early months of the Bosnian war.
